summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K announcing the consummation of its acquisition of 83.40% of Psyga Bio Ltd. in exchange for issuing 33.36% of XTL’s share capital via ADSs, with additional earn-out ADSs/warrants up to 25% upon three milestones. The transaction was approved at an EGM on June 29, 2026, and is an interested-party deal due to director Alex Rabinovich’s 24.9% stake. Psyga Bio becomes a subsidiary; one board seat allocated. A concurrent $1.5M private placement at $2.70/ADS with Series A, B, and C warrants closed. What to watch: integration progress and milestone triggers affecting ownership dilution.
